course.title: Digital World
course.description: A free course with 11 lessons about AI and online information: how AI learns, how to check what you see, and how to stay safe.

sections.title: How AI works
sections.question: How does AI learn, and why does it make mistakes?
sections.description: Find out what AI is, how it learns from examples, and why missing examples lead to mistakes.

sections.title: Check what you see
sections.question: How can I tell if something online is true?
sections.description: Look for clues in fake pictures and voices, check a story before you share it, and spot the signs of a scam.

sections.title: Use tools wisely
sections.question: How can I use online tools safely and well?
sections.description: Keep private things private, ask an AI tool good questions and check its answers, and read numbers with care.

sections.title: AI where you live
sections.question: How could AI help, or harm, a community?
sections.description: Weigh the helps and risks of AI tools in a community, then plan an AI helper of your own.
